versos.grego: Παῦλος δοῦλος Θεοῦ, ἀπόστολος δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ πίστιν ἐκλεκτῶν Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας τῆς κατ’ εὐσέβειαν

controles.web: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
controles.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
controles.livre: Paulo, servo de Deus e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, segundo a fé dos escolhidos de Deus, e o conhecimento da verdade, que é segundo a devoção divina;

versos.grego: ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι ζωῆς αἰωνίου, ἣν ἐπηγγείλατο ὁ ἀψευδὴς Θεὸς πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων,

controles.web: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
controles.kjv: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
controles.livre: em esperança da vida eterna, a qual Deus, que não pode mentir, prometeu antes dos princípios dos tempos,

versos.grego: ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ καιροῖς ἰδίοις τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐν κηρύγματι ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγὼ κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Θεοῦ,

controles.web: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior;
controles.kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
controles.livre: E a seu devido tempo a manifestou: a sua palavra, por meio da pregação, que me foi confiada segundo o mandamento de Deus nosso Salvador.

versos.grego: Τίτῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ κατὰ κοινὴν πίστιν· χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν.

controles.web: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
controles.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
controles.livre: Para Tito, meu verdadeiro filho, segundo a fé em comum; haja em ti graça, misericórdia e paz de Deus Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nosso Salvador.

versos.grego: Τούτου χάριν ἀπέλιπόν σε ἐν Κρήτῃ ἵνα τὰ λείποντα ἐπιδιορθώσῃ, καὶ καταστήσῃς κατὰ πόλιν πρεσβυτέρους, ὡς ἐγώ σοι διεταξάμην,

controles.web: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you;
controles.kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
controles.livre: Por esta causa eu te deixei em Creta, para que tu continuasses a pôr em ordem as coisas que estavam faltando, e de cidade em cidade constituísses presbíteros, conforme eu te mandei.

versos.grego: εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἀνέγκλητος, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἀνήρ, τέκνα ἔχων πιστά, μὴ ἐν κατηγορίᾳ ἀσωτίας ἢ ἀνυπότακτα.

controles.web: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
controles.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
controles.livre: Se alguém for irrepreensível, marido de uma mulher, que tenha filhos fiéis, que não possam ser acusados de serem devassos ou desobedientes.

versos.grego: δεῖ γὰρ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνέγκλητον εἶναι ὡς Θεοῦ οἰκονόμον, μὴ αὐθάδη, μὴ ὀργίλον, μὴ πάροινον, μὴ πλήκτην, μὴ αἰσχροκερδῆ,

controles.web: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward; not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
controles.kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
controles.livre: Porque o supervisor  deve ser irrepreensível, como administrador da casa de Deus, não arrogante, que não se ira facilmente, não beberrão, não agressivo, nem ganancioso.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ φιλόξενον, φιλάγαθον, σώφρονα, δίκαιον, ὅσιον, ἐγκρατῆ,

controles.web: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled;
controles.kjv: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
controles.livre: Mas que ele seja hospitaleiro, ame aquilo que é bom, moderado, justo, santo, e tenha domínio próprio;

versos.grego: ἀντεχόμενον τοῦ κατὰ τὴν διδαχὴν πιστοῦ λόγου, ἵνα δυνατὸς ᾖ καὶ παρακαλεῖν ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ καὶ τοὺς ἀντιλέγοντας ἐλέγχειν.

controles.web: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
controles.kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
controles.livre: Retendo firme a fiel palavra que é conforme o que foi ensinado; para que ele seja capaz, tanto para exortar na sã doutrina, como também para mostrar os erros dos que falam contra ela .

versos.grego: Εἰσὶν γὰρ πολλοὶ ἀνυπότακτοι, ματαιολόγοι καὶ φρεναπάται, μάλιστα οἱ ἐκ τῆς περιτομῆς,

controles.web: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
controles.kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
controles.livre: Porque também há muitos insubordinados, que falam coisas vãs, e enganadores, especialmente aqueles da circuncisão;

versos.grego: οὓς δεῖ ἐπιστομίζειν, οἵτινες ὅλους οἴκους ἀνατρέπουσιν διδάσκοντες ἃ μὴ δεῖ αἰσχροῦ κέρδους χάριν.

controles.web: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
controles.kjv: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
controles.livre: Aos quais devem se calar, que transtornam casas inteiras, ensinando o que não se deve, por causa da ganância.

versos.grego: εἶπέν τις ἐξ αὐτῶν ἴδιος αὐτῶν προφήτης Κρῆτες ἀεὶ ψεῦσται, κακὰ θηρία, γαστέρες ἀργαί.

controles.web: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
controles.kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
controles.livre: Um próprio profeta deles disse: Os cretenses sempre são mentirosos, animais malignos, ventres preguiçosos.

versos.grego: ἡ μαρτυρία αὕτη ἐστὶν ἀληθής. δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν ἔλεγχε αὐτοὺς ἀποτόμως, ἵνα ὑγιαίνωσιν ἐν τῇ πίστει,

controles.web: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
controles.kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
controles.livre: Este testemunho é verdadeiro; por isso repreende-os severamente, para que sejam sãos na fé.

versos.grego: μὴ προσέχοντες Ἰουδαϊκοῖς μύθοις καὶ ἐντολαῖς ἀνθρώπων ἀποστρεφομένων τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

controles.web: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
controles.kjv: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
controles.livre: Não dando atenção a mitos judaicos, e a mandamentos de homens, que desviam da verdade.

versos.grego: πάντα καθαρὰ τοῖς καθαροῖς· τοῖς δὲ μεμιαμμένοις καὶ ἀπίστοις οὐδὲν καθαρόν, ἀλλὰ μεμίανται αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ συνείδησις.

controles.web: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
controles.kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
controles.livre: Realmente todas as coisas são puras para os puros; mas para os contaminados e infiéis, nada é puro; e até o entendimento e a consciência deles estão contaminados.

versos.grego: Θεὸν ὁμολογοῦσιν εἰδέναι, τοῖς δὲ ἔργοις ἀρνοῦνται, βδελυκτοὶ ὄντες καὶ ἀπειθεῖς καὶ πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἀδόκιμοι.

controles.web: They profess that they know God, but by their works they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
controles.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
controles.livre: Eles declaram que conhecem a Deus, mas com as obras eles o negam, pois são abomináveis e desobedientes, e reprovados para toda boa obra.
